## Orientation

Work only in the git worktree ~/aa-wt-label-view-fields (branch task/label-view-fields). Do not edit ~/adaptive-artifacts directly. A parallel executor edits another worktree of the same repo: label-view-fields owns rendering in tools/runtime/handoff.py; recency-selection owns selection in tools/runtime/contract.py and its validation. Touch the other area only if unavoidable. Run the CLI as ./bin/adaptive-artifacts inside the worktree. Commit on the task branch with one Conventional Commit.
